context: Jeremiah Pantaras is a Software Engineer and Full-Stack Developer from the Philippines.
He is the Founder & CEO of Elpisoft, helping startups and MSMEs.
Elpisoft (www.elpisoft.com) is a software development company based in Bacolod City.
He is 23 years old and currently finishing his Bachelor's degree in Computer Science at STI West Negros University.
He is passionate about building a developer community in his region, Negros Island.
Born in Bacolod City, in year 2001.
I started programming in year 2020. learning basic HTMl, CSS, and Javascript.
My complete name is Jeremiah P. Pantaras.
My middle initial stand for Pacheco.
His goal is to build a developer community in his region, Negros Island.
Core Skills: Python (Django), React (Vite), JavaScript, TypeScript.
Interests: Artificial Intelligence, building AI-powered solutions, and using generative AI. Started learning in this  current year 2025.
